remarks: Bright and updated end-unit townhouse available for rent at 18 Prospect in Norwalk offering 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and approximately 960 sq ft of comfortable living space. This well-maintained unit features modern updates throughout, a functional layout with great natural light, and the added privacy that comes with being an end unit. Conveniently located just minutes from downtown Norwalk, the SONO district, restaurants, shopping, Metro-North, and major highways, making commuting and everyday errands incredibly easy. Offered at $2,900 per month, this is a great opportunity to live in a move-in-ready home in a highly accessible location.
